1) 从告警标签取 job/instance 定位是哪个组件（gitaly/pu: 1) Take job/instance from the alert labels to identify the component (gitaly/puma/sidekiq/registry, etc.); 2) On that node run gitlab-ctl status to check the process state; 3) Use gitlab-ctl tail <service> to find the exit reason in the logs; 4) After restarting, run gitlab-rake gitlab:check for an overall health check.
1) 从告警标签取 name 确认是哪个队列积压；2) 在 GitLab 管理后: 1) Take name from the alert labels to identify the backed-up queue; 2) Check queue depth and failed jobs in the GitLab admin Background Jobs page or via gitlab-rails runner; 3) Confirm the Sidekiq process is alive and that concurrency is not set too low (sidekiq['max_concurrency']); 4) If it is caused by mass job failures and retries, find the failure root cause (Redis/PG problems, external timeouts) before clearing them.
1) 在 GitLab 节点用 gitlab-ctl status 确认 pum: 1) On the GitLab node run gitlab-ctl status to check the puma process and look for timeouts in /var/log/gitlab/puma/; 2) Combine with the PumaQueueing alert to judge the queue depth; 3) Short term, raise puma['worker_processes'] and max_threads then run gitlab-ctl reconfigure; 4) Look for slow requests (large MR diffs, big repository pages) holding workers for a long time and rate limit them if needed.
1) 在 Gitaly 节点看日志确认是哪类 RPC 被限流（gitaly_co: 1) On the Gitaly node, check the logs to see which RPCs are being limited (gitaly_concurrency_limiting related); 2) Use gitlab-ctl status plus node CPU/IO to confirm Gitaly is overloaded; 3) Determine whether an oversized repository or a misbehaving client is pulling repeatedly, and throttle that source temporarily; 4) If capacity is genuinely short, raise Gitaly's concurrency limits and add nodes.
1) 在 PG 上确认 log_lock_waits=on，从日志里取死锁双方的: 1) On PostgreSQL confirm log_lock_waits=on and take the full SQL of both deadlock participants from the log; 2) Join pg_locks with pg_stat_activity to identify which two tables are waiting on each other; 3) In GitLab this commonly comes from CI concurrently updating the same records — reduce concurrency or upgrade GitLab (upstream frequently fixes these); 4) Check whether a long transaction is amplifying the deadlock probability.
1) 用 gitlab-ctl tail gitlab-workhorse 看具: 1) Run gitlab-ctl tail gitlab-workhorse to see the exact errors and the failing routes; 2) The usual root cause is a puma timeout or Gitaly being unavailable — confirm both are healthy first; 3) For large-file issues, check disk space and temporary directory permissions; 4) If it lines up with a recent upgrade, roll back first.
1) 登录 PG 节点确认进程存活（gitlab-ctl status post: 1) Log in to the PostgreSQL node and confirm the process is alive (gitlab-ctl status postgresql or systemctl status postgresql); 2) If it is alive, connect by hand with psql to tell a hung instance from a network or pg_hba problem; 3) If it is not running, read the tail of the PG log (full disk, full WAL directory, OOM) before starting it; 4) If a standby exists, assess whether to fail over.
1) 登录 Redis 节点用 gitlab-ctl status redis: 1) Log in to the Redis node and check the process with gitlab-ctl status redis or systemctl status redis; 2) If it is alive, verify with redis-cli ping to tell a hang from a network or password problem; 3) If it is not running, check the logs (OOM, or a full disk breaking the RDB write) before starting it; 4) After recovery, check whether the Sidekiq queues are backed up and watch them drain.
1) 结合 HighPumaUtilization 确认 worker 利用率；: 1) Combine with HighPumaUtilization to confirm worker utilization; 2) Check /var/log/gitlab/puma/puma_stdout.log and the gitlab-rails log for the slowest request paths; 3) Short term, raise puma['worker_processes'] and run gitlab-ctl reconfigure; 4) Longer term, find the root cause of the slow requests (large repositories, large MRs, unindexed queries) and add nodes if needed.
GitLab Workhorse 返回 5xx 的比例偏高。Workhorse: GitLab Workhorse is returning an elevated share of 5xx. Workhorse handles Git HTTP, large file uploads/downloads and LFS, so errors show up directly as clone/push failures.
GitLab 依赖的 PostgreSQL 不可用，GitLab 会整体不可用—: The PostgreSQL that GitLab depends on is unavailable, which takes GitLab down entirely — pages, API and CI all fail.
GitLab 依赖的 Redis 不可用。GitLab 用 Redis 做缓存、: The Redis that GitLab depends on is unavailable. GitLab uses Redis for caching, sessions and the Sidekiq queues, so losing it breaks logins and stops all background jobs.
GitLab 的 PostgreSQL 发生死锁，PostgreSQL 会主动回: A deadlock occurred in GitLab's PostgreSQL; PostgreSQL rolls back one of the transactions and the corresponding GitLab operation fails outright.
Gitaly 的 gRPC 调用出现大量 ResourceExhausted，说: Gitaly gRPC calls are returning many ResourceExhausted responses, which means Gitaly's concurrency limiter is saturated and Git operations (clone/push/CI checkout) will start failing.
Puma 工作进程利用率超过 90%，Web 请求已经排队，页面与 API 响应: Puma worker utilization is above 90%: web requests are queueing and page and API responses will slow noticeably. (This rule relies on GitLab's built-in recording rule instance:puma_utilization:ratio.)
Puma 有连接在排队，说明 worker 已经全忙，用户请求正在等待，页面会明: Puma has queued connections, which means every worker is busy and user requests are waiting; pages will feel noticeably slow.
Sidekiq 队列有任务积压。GitLab 的邮件、CI 触发、仓库同步等都走: Sidekiq queues have a job backlog. GitLab runs email, CI triggers and repository sync through Sidekiq, so a backlog delays all of them noticeably.
有被监控的 GitLab 组件实例不可达，该组件承载的功能中断。: A monitored GitLab component instance is unreachable and the functionality it provides is down.
